title: Bates numbering through pdfxi decorate bates
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli passes; pdfxi decorate bates numbers every page from a real plan, honours start/increment/digits/suffix, places an upright number on a rotated page and rejects invalid configuration; EDIT-010 moves to verified.
notes: Host for build_bates_plan: renders each BatesStamp text at its position through transform_for_page, stamps all pages with PageOperation::StampPages, and reports first/last number.
